titleEn: Solinftec to Launch Ag Robotics’ First Amazon Parts Store as U.S. Solix Acreage Grows 15-Fold
titleZh: Solinftec将推出农业机器人首个亚马逊零件商店，美国Solix作业面积增长15倍
summaryZh: Solinftec宣布将在2026年Farm Progress Show上展示其Solix自主农业平台的持续扩张，包括推出农业机器人领域首个亚马逊零件商店、公布最新田间成果、展示自主加注站如何无需人工干预闭环作业，并预告扩展后的Solix产品线。截至2026年7月，超过100台Solix机器人在13个州和波多黎各运行，覆盖55,427英亩，较三年前增长15倍，化学药剂使用量平均减少85%。公司预计2027种植季部署约200台机器人和80个加注站，并推出四款不同动力和容量的Solix机型。
featuredReason: Solinftec在农业机器人领域的商业化进展——包括自主加注闭环、亚马逊零件直销模式和四机型产品线扩展——代表了农业自动化从概念验证走向规模化运营的标杆案例，对智慧畜牧行业理解自主机器人在大田场景中的落地路径和商业模式具有重要参考价值。
contentFull:
By Solinftec 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 Solinftec, a global leader in artificial intelligence and robotics for agriculture, will showcase the continued expansion of its Solix autonomous farming platform at the 2026 Farm Progress Show, Sept. 1–3 in Boone, Iowa.

 Following its largest U.S. commercial season to date, Solinftec will launch an Amazon store for Solix replacement parts, share new field results, demonstrate how its autonomous Refill Station closes the operating cycle without human intervention and preview the expanded Solix platform. Together, the advancements support what Solinftec calls “Freedom Per Acre,” giving farmers greater flexibility to decide when and how fieldwork is completed.

 Through July 2026, more than 100 Solix robots operated in 13 states and Puerto Rico, covering 55,427 acres – 15 times more acreage than three years ago — and monitoring more than 95 million plants individually. The robots reduced chemical use by an average of 85%, with results remaining between 83% and 89% as the fleet and acreage expanded.

 “For us, agricultural autonomy is about more than removing an operator from the cab,” said Guilherme Guiné, COO at Solinftec. “It is about giving farmers back the ability to make decisions on their own terms. Solix can remain in the field scouting and acting at the agronomic moment while the farmer manages it remotely, works elsewhere or spends time with family.”

 Autonomous refilling closes the operating cycle

 The 2026 growing season marked the first full commercial season for Solinftec’s autonomous Refill Station, which allows Solix to dock, refill and return to work without a farmer traveling to the field.

 Solinftec also improved the performance of its solar-powered Solix robot, doubling its travel speed from one to two miles per hour through updated motors and software refinements while maintaining solar-electric operation.

 Through July 2026, Solix robots completed more than 1,700 autonomous refills, transferring more than 45,000 gallons of product through the Refill Stations. One station alone refilled its accompanying robot more than 120 times, eliminating approximately 120 trips a farmer otherwise would have needed to make to the field.

 “A robot that still requires a person to repeatedly drive to the field and refill it is not fully autonomous,” Guiné said. “Closing that cycle gives farmers something extremely valuable: flexibility in their day. The robot can keep working while they focus on another field, another part of the operation or life away from the farm.”

 Solinftec expects to deploy approximately 200 robots and 80 additional Refill Stations for the 2027 growing season.

 Expanded Solix platform gives farmers more choice

 Solinftec is developing an expanded four-model Solix family designed to give farmers the ability to choose the power source, capacity and field performance that best fit their operations. Every model operates with Solinftec’s ALICE AI platform.

 The family includes the solar-electric Solix X1; battery-electric Solix XT; gas/diesel-powered Solix XR; and hybrid-electric Solix XC. The models range from 50 to 1,200 gallons in capacity and are designed for targeted or targeted-and-broadcast application, depending on the model.

 “No single machine fits every farm,” said Leo Carvalho, Chief Global Strategy Officer at Solinftec. “The product line should fit the farmer — not require the farmer to fit one product. Expanding the Solix family gives farmers more control over the machine, power source and strategy that work best for their acres.”

 At the September Farm Progress Show, Solinftec plans to preview the gas/diesel-powered Solix XR, which is expected to be commercially available for the 2027 growing season.

 Amazon parts store expands farmer self-service

 During the Farm Progress Show, Solinftec will also launch an Amazon store offering certain Solix replacement parts directly to farmers. The company says it is the first agricultural robotics company to offer its replacement parts through Amazon. The move is part of Solinftec’s effort to make Solix increasingly self-service, allowing farmers to purchase robots directly from Solinftec, receive remote support and complete many routine repairs themselves.

 The current Solix robot is priced at $55,000, and Solinftec estimates growers can recover that cost in approximately 2.5 years based solely on projected input savings. The estimate does not include potential savings from labor, fuel, equipment use or additional field passes.

 Farm Progress Show 2026

 At the Farm Progress Show, Solinftec will have an expanded booth with a live demonstration area where attendees can see Solix identify and treat simulated weeds and autonomously use the Refill Station. Children and families can also try Solix Defender, a tablet-based game that simulates the robot’s targeted weed-control process and is expected to be released publicly through Apple’s App Store and Google Play.

 Solinftec will exhibit at booth 15N. To schedule an interview or demonstration with a Solinftec representative or participating Iowa farmer, contact Angela Tuell, [email protected] or 317-567-9126.

translationZh:
Solinftec是农业人工智能和机器人领域的全球领导者，将在2026年9月1日至3日于爱荷华州布恩举行的Farm Progress Show上展示其Solix自主农业平台的持续扩张。

在迄今为止最大的美国商业化季节之后，Solinftec将推出Solix替换零件的亚马逊商店，分享新的田间成果，演示其自主加注站如何在无需人工干预的情况下闭环作业，并预览扩展后的Solix平台。这些进展共同支持了Solinftec所称的“每英亩自由”，让农民在决定何时以及如何完成田间作业方面拥有更大的灵活性。

截至2026年7月，超过100台Solix机器人在13个州和波多黎各运行，覆盖55,427英亩——比三年前增长了15倍——并单独监测了超过9,500万株植物。这些机器人将化学药剂使用量平均减少了85%，随着机队和作业面积的扩大，结果保持在83%至89%之间。

“对我们来说，农业自主性不仅仅是把操作员从驾驶室中解放出来，”Solinftec首席运营官Guilherme Guiné表示。“它关乎把按自己的条件做决定的权力还给农民。Solix可以留在田间，在最佳农时进行巡查和作业，而农民可以远程管理它、在其他地方工作或与家人共度时光。”

**自主加注闭环作业周期**

2026种植季是Solinftec自主加注站的第一个完整商业季，该加注站允许Solix自主停靠、加注并返回工作，无需农民前往田间。

Solinftec还改进了其太阳能驱动的Solix机器人的性能，通过更新的电机和软件优化，将其行进速度从每小时1英里提升至2英里，同时保持太阳能电力运行。

截至2026年7月，Solix机器人完成了超过1,700次自主加注，通过加注站转移了超过45,000加仑的药剂。仅一个加注站就为其配套机器人加注了120多次，相当于消除了农民原本需要前往田间的约120次行程。

“一个仍然需要人反复开车到田间为其加注的机器人，算不上完全自主，”Guiné说。“闭环这个循环给了农民极其宝贵的东西：一天中的灵活性。机器人可以继续工作，而他们专注于另一块田地、运营的另一部分或农场之外的生活。”

Solinftec预计在2027种植季部署约200台机器人和80个额外的加注站。

**扩展的Solix平台为农民提供更多选择**

Solinftec正在开发一个扩展的四机型Solix系列，旨在让农民能够选择最适合其运营的动力源、容量和田间性能。每款机型都搭载Solinftec的ALICE AI平台运行。

该系列包括太阳能电力驱动的Solix X1；电池电力驱动的Solix XT；燃气/柴油驱动的Solix XR；以及混合电力驱动的Solix XC。这些机型的容量从50加仑到1,200加仑不等，根据机型不同，设计用于靶向或靶向兼广谱喷洒。

“没有一台机器能适合所有农场，”Solinftec首席全球战略官Leo Carvalho表示。“产品线应该适应农民——而不是要求农民去适应一款产品。扩展Solix系列让农民对最适合其耕地的机器、动力源和策略拥有更多控制权。”

在九月的Farm Progress Show上，Solinftec计划预览燃气/柴油驱动的Solix XR，该机型预计将在2027种植季实现商业可用。

**亚马逊零件商店扩展农民自助服务**

在Farm Progress Show期间，Solinftec还将推出一个亚马逊商店，直接向农民提供部分Solix替换零件。该公司表示，这是首家通过亚马逊提供替换零件的农业机器人公司。此举是Solinftec致力于让Solix日益自助化的一部分，允许农民直接从Solinftec购买机器人、获得远程支持并自行完成许多日常维修。

当前Solix机器人售价为55,000美元，Solinftec估计仅基于预期的投入品节省，种植者约在2.5年内即可收回成本。该估算不包括劳动力、燃料、设备使用或额外田间作业可能带来的节省。

**2026年Farm Progress Show**

在Farm Progress Show上，Solinftec将拥有一个扩大的展位，设有现场演示区，参观者可以看到Solix识别和处理模拟杂草，并自主使用加注站。儿童和家庭还可以试玩Solix Defender，这是一款基于平板电脑的游戏，模拟机器人的靶向除草过程，预计将通过苹果App Store和Google Play公开发布。

Solinftec将在15N号展位展出。如需与Solinftec代表或参与的爱荷华州农民安排采访或演示，请联系Angela Tuell，邮箱[email protected]或电话317-567-9126。
